fact: Loi n° 2017-20, the Code du numerique, was promulgated by the President on 20 April 2018 after adoption by the National Assembly and Constitutional Court review, and contains a title on the obligations of trust service providers (articles 305-306: freedom of establishment, duty of declaration).
